top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The sign in and out log was not maintained.     Corrected at Inspection: The times and initials were placed for those who had not been sign in.

top_violation_types.title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: In the infant classroom, there was a 3 month child asleep that was placed on there tummy who is not independently able to roll on there back.     CI: This was corrected at the inspection as the child was place on there back.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four out of ten staff trainings records reviewed are missing training certificates for First Aid/CPR and health/safety annual trainings.
